content.title: Leak Hints at First Intel Nvidia Chip After $5 Billion Partnership
content.summary: Intel (INTC, Financials) and Nvidia (NVDA, Financials) may be preparing to ship their first jointly developed chip, according to leaked details about a laptop processor called Serpent Lake.  The leak, shared by YouTube channel RedGamingTec, suggests the chip will combine Intel CPUs with Nvidia RTX graphics in a single design.  Serpent Lake is expected to pair Intel's upcoming Titan Lake CPU architecture with Nvidia's RTX Rubin graphics, manufactured on TSMC's 3-nanometer process.
